summary: Iteration 12 — Validated password-reset (admin + client + rate-limit + role-on-success) and the new Claude AI draft endpoints (/ai/draft-quote, /ai/draft-invoice). All 10 new pytest cases pass. Frontend sanity passes on RenovationPage TV promo, ClientLogin forgot-link, MobilierPage 'À partir de' rows, and EntretienPage prices (140$/200$/450$).

issues: React hydration warning: a <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapper (visual-editor instrumentation) is rendered between <tbody> and <tr>, producing 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' console errors. Not user-visible but pollutes console and risks hydration mismatches. Likely originates from the static-imported pricing array wrapper.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Suppress the <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapper inside <tbody> on MobilierPage to clear the hydration warning; the same pattern may exist on other tabular pages.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_extensions: rate-limit window is 15 min and threshold is 3 (RATE_LIMIT_RESET_MAX=3), so the 4th request correctly yields 429 — confirmed by test.
reset-password correctly returns {success, message, role} (defaults to 'client' if role is unset). Frontend can branch on role to pick admin vs. client login.

ai_drafts: prompt-only path works end-to-end with the seeded EMERGENT_LLM_KEY; Claude returns valid JSON parsed by AIQuoteDraft/AIInvoiceDraft Pydantic models. No 500/502s observed in ~20s round-trips.
_extract_json fallback handles ```json fenced replies — good defensive parsing.
Reset-password endpoint scans all unused/non-expired tokens with bcrypt.checkpw — O(n) but bounded to 200 docs; acceptable for current scale.
Tests deliberately reset admin password back to ADMIN_PASSWORD so the seeded credential remains valid for subsequent runs (idempotent).
seed_data_creation: Test inserts a temporary password_reset_tokens doc for the admin user (used immediately and marked used_at). Also creates a TEST_client_*@example.com client via /api/v1/client/register; left in DB (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New test file /app/backend/tests/test_auth_reset_and_ai_drafts.py is reusable as a regression. It depends on MONGO_URL and DB_NAME being in the backend env (which they are). The reset-password test resets admin password to the SAME value to keep the seeded login working. AI tests take ~15-25s due to live Claude calls.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in the under-test features. The only console-level issue is a pre-existing React hydration warning on MobilierPage caused by the visual-editor's <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapper inside <tbody> — not introduced by this iteration's work.
